name: Ethylhexyl cocoate
description: Ethylhexyl cocoate (CAS 92044-87-6 ) is an ester derived from coconut fatty acids and 2-ethylhexyl alcohol, functioning as an emollient, carrier, and lubricant across personal care and industrial applications. Its low viscosity and skin-compatible profile make it a practical alternative to mineral oil in cosmetic formulations. Procurement teams source it as a multifunctional base ingredient where lightweight skin feel is a priority. In personal care, it is used in sunscreens, body oils, and leave-on skin care products as an emollient that improves texture and aids active ingredient delivery without a greasy residue. Color cosmetics manufacturers incorporate it as a dispersing agent for pigments in foundations and lip products. In lubricant formulations, it functions as a bio-based base fluid or additive. Low-toxicity and biodegradability are key procurement requirements for this material. Coatings and adhesive formulators use it as a plasticizing component and processing aid to improve flexibility. Ethylhexyl cocoate is supplied as a clear, pale yellow liquid in drum and IBC quantities, with bulk tanker options available for larger industrial volumes. It is offered in cosmetic-grade specifications. The material meets the purity requirements of major personal care markets.
